item.title: Iran, Uzbekistan agree to ease transit and revive regional corridors
item.description: Roads minister says a joint committee will be formed to restore corridor links between the two countries and the wider region.

item.title: Lebanon’s Grand Shia Mufti: Iran, Resistance shape regional order after historic US defeat
item.description: Lebanon’s Grand Shia Mufti says Iran is pivotal to shaping West Asia’s future security and political equations, describing the US war of aggression against the Islamic Republic as a historic defeat for Washington.

item.title: Three World Cups, countless memories and an emotional goodbye: Saman Ghoddos’s Team Melli journey
item.description: Saman Ghoddos bids farewell to Team Melli after nine years, three World Cups and two Asian Cups, with 41 appearances, valuable contributions and an enduring bond with Iranian fans.

item.title: Iranian Army shoots down US MQ-1 drone off southern coast
item.description: Iran’s Army Navy intercepts and destroys a US MQ-1 drone near the coastal area of Kuhestak in the country’s southern Hormozgan Province.

item.title: Massive explosion as violating LPG carrier hits naval mine east of Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: An LPG carrier caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine as the violating carrier tried to pass through an unauthorized route, says the IRGC.

item.title: Iranians bid farewell to 350 unidentified martyrs of Iraqi imposed war on Iran
item.description: A mass funeral procession is held in the Iranian capital of Tehran for 110 unidentified martyrs of Iraq's 1980-88 war under former dictator Saddam Hussein on neighboring Iran.

item.title: Iraq, Turkey, Pakistan defy US pressure to close borders with Iran: Report
item.description: The US has failed to persuade Iraq, Pakistan and Turkey to close their borders with Iran, undermining Washington’s efforts to restrict Tehran’s land trade routes, according to a report.

item.title: ‘Unacceptable’: Iran rejects UK’s claims of involvement in violent, espionage acts
item.description: Iran dismisses as “unacceptable” British authorities’ accusations about the Islamic Republic’s involvement in acts of violence and espionage activities in the UK.

item.title: Pezeshkian: Iran not responsible for regional situation; Israel pushed Trump into war
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stresses that the Islamic Republic is not responsible for the current situation in the region.

item.title: Iran, Kazakhstan stress expansion of ICT cooperation
item.description: Iran and Kazakhstan have stressed the need to expand bilateral and regional cooperation in communications and information technology.

item.title: Iran warns foreign governments against involvement in US aggression, economic terrorism
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman has rejected the G7 statement, warning that any foreign military or logistical support for US aggression would constitute participation in unlawful acts under international law.

item.title: Iran, Uzbekistan stress expansion of rail, road, transit cooperation
item.description: Iran and Uzbekistan have emphasized the need to expand transport cooperation, facilitate transit and strengthen regional trade and logistics links.

item.title: Multiple rallies in Yemen against Saudi attacks on civilians
item.description: Multiple rallies were held in Yemen, denouncing Saudi attacks on civilians.

item.title: Dozens injured in New Orleans tanker–cruise ship collision
item.description: A tanker collision with a docked cruise ship on the Mississippi River left dozens injured, partially capsized the vessel, and prompted a major rescue operation.

item.title: Viewer discretion advised: Truck and bus collision in India's Assam kills at least 23 people
item.description: At least 23 people were killed and several others were injured after a container truck collided with a bus in India's northeastern state of Assam.
